title: Retire legacy Workforce compatibility surfaces
goal: Retire legacy Workforce navigation, writers, adapters, and feature flag only after sustained zero usage and complete operating-cycle evidence.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WFC has operated at 100 percent for at least 30 days and two complete schedule/payroll cycles
Legacy route/read/write usage is zero for 30 consecutive days
No unexplained parity mismatch or unmatched historical record remains
All legacy URLs have tested permanent mappings
Historical records remain queryable under an approved retention plan
Flag removal occurs only after fallback removal and registry validation

progress.summary: Blocked until governed rollout completes and the mandatory observation window passes.
next_steps: CP-103: legacy retirement covers the pre-existing components/admin/workforce/ files and the app/admin/dashboard/staff legacy surface. It must not delete WFC-008..WFC-020 deliverables, and WFC-007's components/ui/** primitives are out of scope entirely.
Begin the observation clock only after WFC-022 reaches monitored 100 percent
Inventory legacy consumers and retain audit-history requirements
blockers: WFC must be at 100 percent for 30 days
Two complete schedule/payroll cycles must pass
Legacy usage must remain zero for 30 consecutive days

handoffs: Return legacy-retirement evidence and final WFC program closure to Orchestrator
